Rights-gated access enforces legal boundaries, preventing unauthorized cloud storage. Dualities emerge between current local practices and future AWS-ready states, with failure modes occurring at boundary conditions—such as ambiguous rights or incomplete manifests. These primitives collectively enable a robust, scalable, and legally sound data ecosystem.
